findings.description: Insecure temporary file creation for lock file using os.open with predictable filename and insufficient atomicity checks.
findings.reasoning: The lock file is created using os.open with O_CREAT|O_EXCL, but the filename is predictable (self.lock_file) and there is no use of a secure temporary file mechanism. This can allow an attacker to pre-create a symlink or file at the lock path, leading to race conditions or privilege escalation. The permissions are set via self._context.mode, but the atomicity and unpredictability of the filename are not guaranteed.
